measurement: a Lean compile is NOT atomic per declaration; the wrapper made it look that way
the_correction: LL.md recorded as F7 that 'a Lean compile is atomic: one failing obligation fails the whole file and yields no per-declaration rows'. That was verify_file's behaviour, not Lean's. It returns a single aggregate failure the instant returncode != 0, discarding the per-declaration axiom lines the kernel had already printed.

the_decisive_observation.command: lake env lean <one file with 8 candidates, indices 2 and 5 false>
verbatim: 'At2.At2_m' depends on axioms: [propext, sorryAx, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
the_decisive_observation.reading: A failed tactic proof is admitted as sorryAx and reported by name, which is exactly what the gate already rejects on. Nothing needed isolating.

consequences: Isolation costs ZERO extra invocations. The bisection (11 and 15 at 2 and 4 failures of 8) and the flat fall-back that replaced it (9) were both solving a problem the wrapper invented.
The batching break-even (1-p)^b > 1/b no longer binds: the saving is b at ANY failure rate, so the high-failure regime an evolutionary search occupies stops being a barrier.

results/lean_numeric_screen.json's headline justification is void. The screen is still sound and still removes elaboration work, but it was motivated as an escape from a limit that was an artifact of this wrapper.
why_dropping_the_exit_code_is_still_soun: The source-forgery scan still runs, rejecting #exit truncation and #print string spoofing.
Every declared theorem must have its OWN axioms line; one that never elaborated prints nothing and fails as unchecked.
That line must be free of sorryAx and of non-whitelisted axioms.
A nonzero exit therefore only says some declaration failed, which the per-name checks catch. Nothing is accepted that verify_file would have accepted.
not_established: One run per scenario; invocation counts are exact, wall-clock is a single sample on a host whose same-input spread reached 2.81x.
--json was not needed: plain stdout already carries the per-declaration lines.
